summary: Drift now shows every extra item, and Admin accounts always shows department owners.

fixes.title: Drift shows every extra
fixes.text: Drift now lists every extra item. An area over the removal limit says its removals would be held for review.

fixes.title: Department owners shown correctly
fixes.text: Admin accounts no longer says a department has no owners after you opened Reports or Look up a role.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The connectivity check reaches Azure again, a hand-set registry name is cleaned up, and a repeated message is fixed.
